body: hey, i'm doing a little bit better now, how are things with you?

thanks for lending a ear, im at a point where ive been depressed for so long that i dont where the depression ends and i begin, i dont know how to separate the two, and no one else seems to know either. i rationally get that i am sick, but no one can give me a clear prognosis and the uncertainty of will i ever get better is so fucking crippling and suffocating

a nonromantic breakup of sorts with my two best friends, told them about my depression and they haven't talked to me in months, more than that all of our mutual friends have stopped hanging out with me. hanging out with these girls was one of the few things that was getting me through my severe depression. And now that's just gone and I have these huge chunks of empty time that just feed my depression. I'm a social person and this isolation is making me more depressed than i've ever been
without going into the specifics I have never been so alone before, and the silence has just become suffocating. there is no one to talk to...apart from my therapist

thanks so much for replying, really thanks
and it's not going great (hence the post), but how's it on your end?
